newsitem.title: USA: Clinton "thrilled" by reports of Yeltsin recovery.
newsitem.headline: Clinton "thrilled" by reports of Yeltsin recovery.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton said on Monday he was "thrilled" by reports of Russian President Boris Yeltsin's recovery from heart surgery last month.

"We're all thrilled at the reports we get of President Yeltsin's excellent recovery from his surgery," Clinton said at an event honouring U.S. astronaut Shannon Lucid, who spent more than six months on the Russian space station Mir.
Yeltsin, 65, underwent quintuple heart bypass surgery on Nov. 5.
